purpose: Test whether receipt-grounded Keymaster/Pivot-Slime + M2R structural memory can reduce online exact R5 work by choosing only the first exact R5 split, while preserving unchanged C025/R5 proof authority, decisive coverage, exact fallback and all replay invariants.

R5_evidence_prerequisite.required_state: R5 finite SAT rescue, UNSAT rescue and repeated-residual hash-cons evidence planes closed in scoped frozen tests before R6
R5_evidence_prerequisite.known_open_frontier_preserved: GT8 development remains R5 OPEN with node/depth resource exhaustion

authority_constitution.canonical_decisive_result: replay-confirm and return; R6 is not invoked
authority_constitution.canonical_OPEN: compute frozen baseline R5 reference, then run R6 root-route ecology from original CNF

finalized_calibration_sources.rule: Only historical formulas already named in merged finalized R5 receipts may seed calibration. For each such historical subject, R6 may generate new exact forced-root calibration receipts before holdout; every calibration route must independently verify its root split and exact final replay. Calibration is completed and memory frozen before any holdout formula is evaluated.

structural_feature_plane.source: Keymaster pivot feature microscope pre-elimination structural plane
forbidden: local numeric pivot ID as transferable feature
probe outcome from the current formula
exact elimination pair enumeration during feature extraction

M2R_context_bucket.bucket_hash: stable canonical JSON SHA256 prefix 24 hex characters

candidate_views.R5_BASELINE: unchanged R5 branch_pressure selected root pivot
candidate_views.CONFLICT_CANCELLATION: maximum single_conflict_mass_per_pair, ties lower parent_pairs then canonical_index
candidate_views.STRUCTURAL_DIVERSITY: maximum Manhattan distance from LOW_PAIR_RISK if distinct else R5_BASELINE over within-root min-max normalized axes [degree_d,balance_ratio,parent_pairs,parent_mean_width_sum,retained_units,conflict_per_pair,aligned_per_pair,overlap_per_pair], ties canonical_index

exact_calibration_episode.for_each_historical_formula: only if canonical C025 is OPEN; canonical decisive historical formulas contribute no R6 route-cost episode
for_each_candidate_view: construct both children with unchanged C025 restrict
independently verify the exact root split with unchanged R5 verify_split
continue below root with unchanged R5Context branch_pressure, hash-consing, C025 child solver, caps, node budget and max depth
compose SAT or UNSAT only under unchanged exact R5 semantics
independently replay any decisive route receipt
exact_calibration_episode.decisive_route_target: combined exact execution work = child_C025_exact_paid_work + structural_work + split_verification_work; replay work stored separately
exact_calibration_episode.OPEN_route: store immutable exposure receipt but do not convert OPEN to numeric bad-cost target and do not treat it as failure evidence

M2R_memory_fit.method: Welford count/mean/M2 of decisive exact execution work per donor coarse context bucket plus global decisive Welford aggregate
M2R_memory_fit.unsupported_bucket: no numeric prediction; candidate may remain diversity shadow but cannot become memory-best
M2R_memory_fit.model_weights: none in R6; this gate isolates exact receipt-grounded aggregate memory before neural teacher/student training
M2R_memory_fit.memory_state_identity: includes R5 runtime blob, C025 blob, donor commit, calibration episode digest and aggregate digest

Keymaster_online_selection.input: current canonical-OPEN root structural candidate views plus frozen M2R memory
Keymaster_online_selection.memory_best: supported candidate with minimum predicted_execution_work, ties by candidate view order then canonical index
Keymaster_online_selection.diversity_alternate: among supported candidates distinct from memory_best, choose maximum Manhattan feature distance from memory_best; if none supported use a distinct candidate only as shadow and never execute it

exploration_floor.action: execute supported diversity alternate if one exists; otherwise execute memory_best/baseline
exploration_floor.purpose: prevent permanent champion lock without randomness or same-run learning

Keymaster_online_selection.top_k_plan: memory_best, supported diversity alternate if any, R5 baseline if distinct; plan is advisory metadata only

on_canonical_OPEN: execute unchanged standard R5 once as frozen reference baseline and record full exact work
derive R6 structural features and advisory root route from frozen memory
execute one exact-verified forced root split followed by unchanged R5 below root
if forced route returns replay-clean SAT/UNSAT, it is eligible as R6 exact result
if forced route returns OPEN or fails admission, execute unchanged standard R5 fallback from the original root and charge both attempts
if baseline R5 is decisive and R6 exact result contradicts it, hard fail
if baseline R5 is decisive and R6 forced route is OPEN, fallback must restore the baseline result or hard fail

source_identity_cold_reset.if_any_of_R5_blob_C025_blob_donor_commit: disable frozen memory predictions and fall back to R5 baseline; retain immutable calibration history but mark aggregates stale

online_work_accounting.baseline_execution_work: sum unchanged R5 combined_fallback_work for every canonical-OPEN formula
online_work_accounting.baseline_full_work: baseline_execution_work + unchanged R5 decisive replay work
online_work_accounting.R6_execution_work: selected forced-route combined execution work + any exact R5 fallback execution work
online_work_accounting.R6_full_work: R6_execution_work + all selected-route/fallback replay work + feature/inference work
online_work_accounting.feature_inference_work: frozen feature_work_charge_per_call + 8 units per candidate context lookup + 8 units per supported candidate prediction + 8 units for selection/diversity bookkeeping
online_work_accounting.calibration_work: reported separately and never hidden from amortized totals
online_work_accounting.reason: first R6 gate isolates online routing effect after a frozen prior-receipt calibration state; it may not claim amortized end-to-end speedup
online_work_accounting.amortized_total_calibration_plus_online: required reporting only, no PASS claim
